## Summary

Describe the user-facing or operational change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Repository hygiene, unit tests, typecheck and lint pass.
- [ ] Relevant browser or integration tests pass (or explain why not applicable).
- [ ] User-facing changes were checked at desktop and mobile sizes.
- [ ] No credentials, private documents or generated artifacts are included.

## Release Impact

List migrations, configuration changes, extension updates or worker changes.
State whether staging validation is required and describe rollback considerations.
Merging does not automatically deploy production.
